g.text: A strength gym carried through one continuous scroll narrative — manifesto to membership.
"WE DO NOT TRAIN TO BURN CALORIES.
Raw material. Pressure. Repetition. Refinement. Stronger form.
Five chapters on one continuous scroll — built to be walked through rather than screenshotted.
Develop force, stability and structural integrity.
Build a repeatable engine: intervals, output, recovery.
Own your range so positions hold under load.
One coach, one plan, built around your numbers.
Small groups and real eyes on every rep.
Full open facility access, platforms, saunas and locker suite.
All Club access + coached programming blocks & weekly metric audit.
Full access + dedicated 1-on-1 personal coach, programming & nutrition.
Intake opens quarterly. 240 active members maximum per facility.
